title: CORS misconfiguration check
objective: Inspect whether the API returns permissive CORS headers (Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *) alongside credentialed endpoints.
input_scenario: Send OPTIONS/GET to /diagnose and inspect response headers for Access-Control-* values.
expected_behavior: CORS is restricted to known origins; wildcard '*' is not paired with credentialed requests.
severity_justification_hint: Permissive CORS with credentials allows malicious sites to make authenticated requests on a victim's behalf.
observations: The request returned HTTP 405 Method Not Allowed, and no Access-Control-Allow-Origin or other CORS headers were present in the response.
conclusion: No permissive CORS configuration was observed, although the CORS policy was not fully evaluated because the requested method was rejected.
